title: Migration Act 1978 (Chapter 16)
topic: entry and stay; removal; detention; refugees
amended: Migration (Amendment) Acts No. 15 of 1982, No. 10 of 1989 and No. 15 of 1996 (as noted in this copy); later amendments not shown
source_tier: UN-hosted copy (UNODC SHERLOC), not a government site
note: Consolidated text with amendment footnotes up to 1996; the certification date is blank. Entry only with an entry permit (s. 3, replaced 1996); conditions of entry and cancellation with a Committee of Review (ss. 5-6); unlawful presence (s. 7); removal orders and power to detain and remove (ss. 12-13); carrier duties (s. 15). Inserted in 1989: the Minister may decide that a non-citizen is a refugee (s. 15A), declare relocation centres (s. 15B) and direct a refugee or asylum claimant to live in one, with police power to detain and use force (s. 15C). No appeal against decisions of the Minister (s. 19). Offences carry a fine of up to K5,000 or six months in prison (s. 16). Later amendments, including any changes made for the Manus Island centre (whose detention the Supreme Court held unconstitutional in Namah v Pato, 2016), are not in this copy: find the current consolidated text on PacLII or from the Immigration and Citizenship Authority.

title: Criminal Code (Amendment) Act 2026
topic: travel and identity document fraud; smuggling; penalties
source_tier: official (certified print hosted by the Bank of Papua New Guinea)
note: Certified print: made by the National Parliament on 1 Sep 2026 by absolute majority; certified by the Speaker and the Acting Clerk on 30 Sep 2026. Mainly an anti-money-laundering and counter-financing package (firearms trafficking, terrorist and weapons of mass destruction financing, fraud penalties). Migration-relevant part: s. 22 replaces the penalty in Criminal Code s. 206E (falsifying travel and identity documents or approval to travel or stay documents) with up to 15 years in prison for a natural person or a fine of up to K75,000 for a body corporate. It also adds offences of trafficking firearms into or out of the country (new Division 4A, ss. 78A-78F). Commencement date not stated in the scanned text: check the National Gazette.
